records.name: How Hueman Are You?
records.tagline: Find the odd tile before the clock runs out
records.description: Meet HUEMAN: a free daily color game that’s like Wordle, but for your eyes. If you grew up on games like Kuku Kube or I Love Hue, or you just need a new 2-minute challenge for your morning puzzle rotation, HUEMAN is built for you. Every day at midnight UTC, a new puzzle drops. It’s the exact same puzzle for everyone on Earth.

records.name: agentbrowse
records.tagline: Give your AI coding agent the web as a command line
records.description: AI coding agents are great in a terminal and clumsy in a browser. agentbrowse turns any website into a CLI they drive it can open, snapshot, click, fill, read as clean markdown, even log in. One command makes Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini & Windsurf use it by default.

records.name: Edgee Turbo Models
records.tagline: Use Claude Code with Kimi K2.7 Code, MiniMax M2.7, and more
records.description: Run state-of-the-art open-source models (GLM 5.1, Kimi K2.7 Code, MiniMax M2.7, and more) in Claude Code at up to 4× the speed (up to 200 tok/s) for a flat $29/month. Set up in minutes, no code changes.

records.name: Vidrunner
records.tagline: Publish YouTube videos faster with AI
records.description: Generate accurate YouTube timestamps, keyword-rich tags, and Amazon product links from any video. Paste a URL, pick what you need, copy and paste into YouTube. Start free.

records.name: Obotiq
records.tagline: Autonomous care robots that give caregivers time back
records.description: Obotiq builds autonomous robots that handles routine non clinical work in care facilities, reducing caregiver burnout and giving care teams more time for the moments that matter.

records.name: whoburnedmore
records.tagline: Spotify Wrapped for Claude, Codex & a Public leaderboard.
records.description: Run `npx whoburnedmore` and get an instant dashboard of your AI coding usage - tokens, cost, tool usages, mcps, skill & all else across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Open code and 12 more in a single place. Then land on a live public leaderboard and compare it with others. Free and open source.

records.name: FableWatch
records.tagline: Know the second Fable 5 is back
records.description: An automated return monitor for claude-fable-5. We ping the API every 60 seconds. The instant it answers again, we light up your email, text you, and call you!

records.name: Revi
records.tagline: On-device voice dictation. No cloud, no account.
records.description: Revi turns your voice into text in every app on your computer. Everything runs on-device — no cloud, no account, no subscription. 25+ languages with automatic detection, on-device engines (Whisper, Parakeet, Apple), a built-in clipboard manager, and it stays silent in password fields. Pay €7.99 once, yours forever. Mac · Windows · Linux.

records.name: DualCam AI
records.tagline: Record front and rear cameras at once
records.description: DualCam AI is an AI-built iPhone camera app for capturing two perspectives in one take. Record or shoot with the front and rear cameras at the same time, choose from six instant layouts, adjust the front-camera window while filming, and save a polished MP4 directly to Photos. It is built for creators, reporters, educators, and anyone recording moments that cannot be repeated.

records.name: looquee
records.tagline: Copilot for college applications
records.description: Looquee's AI combines trusted admission data with your profile, interests, and activities to give you truly personalized college app support. It automatically tracks deadlines, requirements, and everything you need to apply. Looquee helps students discover colleges, find scholarships, organize applications, brainstorm and polish essays, and navigate the process from start to finish.

records.name: Stash
records.tagline: A tactile control layer for MacOS
records.description: Stash is a hidden tactile control layer for your Mac. Reveal your Dock overflow, edge sliders, and corner dials only when you need them — then let them disappear when you’re done. Hide up to 8 apps, adjust volume and brightness, toggle appearance, control keyboard backlight, and switch audio outputs with physical-feeling controls built around haptics, subtle sound, and smooth motion. Stash runs quietly from the menu bar, includes a 24-hour free trial, and is built for macOS Tahoe.

records.name: Avocado
records.tagline: AI-native content operations for any Next.js website
records.description: Bring AI-native editing, content operations, and agentic workflows to your existing Next.js stack — without replacing your CMS, DAM, or design system. Self-hostable. BYO AI models. Live demo: https://avocado-editor.vercel.app/

records.name: HTML Deployer
records.tagline: Deploy sites from AI chat to published HTML
records.description: HTML Deployer helps you publish HTML as a live website quickly. Deploy HTML from ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini to Netlify, GitHub, FTP or your own server in a few clicks.

records.name: Tendlet
records.tagline: Know, plan, and share care for pets and plants
records.description: Tendlet helps you care for pets and plants with suggested routines, meal plans, and a cited field guide. Try the demo at tendlet.app/demo

records.name: Bitli.st
records.tagline: Sell your product before you build it
records.description: Start collecting emails or payments in minutes not hours

records.name: Fluxmail
records.tagline: AI email inbox and assistant
records.description: Fluxmail is an AI email app that helps founders prioritize urgent emails, draft replies in your voice, and follow up on messages.

records.name: Container Desktop
records.tagline: A GUI for Apple's native container system
records.description: A native, Docker Desktop-style macOS app for Apple's container CLI. Containers, images, volumes, networks and machines — free and open source.

records.name: Ledgerly
records.tagline: Available on the App Store
records.description: Ledgerly is now available on the App Store.

records.name: Mood
records.tagline: A quiet record of how you feel
records.description: A quiet record of how you feel. Tap, label, pixel. Day by day.

records.name: TimedSubs
records.tagline: Script-first subtitle timing for voiceover videos
records.description: TimedSubs turns your approved script and matching voiceover into timed subtitle files. It keeps the script as the source of truth, checks timing before export, and delivers SRT, VTT, SBV, ASS, TXT, JSON, and ZIP for editing and handoff.

records.name: Kepler
records.tagline: Agentic development environment to run agents at scale
records.description: Run more agents. Merge more code. Kepler is GitKraken’s agentic development environment (ADE). It gives you full clarity and control to run parallel agents at scale: plan work, write code, and review what ships, all from one surface.

records.name: Flows · Time Tracker
records.tagline: Most time trackers are built for billing. Flows isn’t.
records.description: Time doesn’t stop when you finish a task. Neither does Flows. Tap a flow to start tracking. Tap another to switch. No projects, no tasks, no timesheets. Just a simple, visual picture of where your attention went. Built for people who want awareness, not surveillance.

records.name: Eidentic
records.tagline: The TypeScript SDK for AI agents with self-improving memory
records.description: Open-source (Apache-2.0) TypeScript SDK for AI agents. A four-tier self-improving memory engine plus the production fundamentals built in — durable runs, enforced cost ceilings, evals in CI, GDPR erasure. Runs on Node, Bun, Deno, and the edge.

records.name: detectly
records.tagline: Turn your fleet's dashcam footage into driver safety scores
records.description: Fleet managers have dashcams on every vehicle. Almost none of the footage ever gets watched as there simply isn't time. We built detectly to fix that. Upload a clip and the AI automatically flags dangerous incidents: following too close, cut-ins, pedestrian hazards, and more. Every driver gets a risk score. Annotated clips are ready to review in minutes. No manual review. No new hardware. Works with any dashcam footage you already have.

records.name: Tychi AI
records.tagline: The economic layer for autonomous capital.
records.description: Tychi is a self-custody wallet built for AI agents with a human REPL on the same keystore. Most agent “wallets” are custodial APIs or read-only tools. Tychi ships two surfaces: tyi-mcp (Cursor, Claude, OpenClaw) and tyi CLI. Keys stay on your machine; signing never leaves it. Policy caps run before every onchain action. Agent-native flow: route → status → fast wallet ops, or chat for balances/sends/payments. Multi-wallet, onboard, gasless routing.

records.name: Handover
records.tagline: A delivery page that feels as finished as the work
records.description: Handover gives every project a more considered way to send the inevitable tangle of scattered cloud service links. Bring the links, context, and next steps into one client-ready page, then send one clear link instead of stitching the handover together in email. Publish one page. The receiver opens it. Thats it for them. No account, no portal, no login. Free during beta.

records.name: Amaroad
records.tagline: Build AI slide decks without leaving your terminal
records.description: Amaroad is an open-source AI-first slide authoring environment for developers. Ask Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, or Cursor to create and refine decks from your terminal, preview slides live, edit multiple slides in parallel, and export to PDF/PPTX or share a live URL.

records.name: Bodhiorchard
records.tagline: Vibe-code your whole project with 12 autonomous AI agents
records.description: Bodhiorchard replaces story points, standups, and stale tickets with 12 specialised AI agents. They draft every spec, forecast cycle times with Monte Carlo, and tend your codebase like an orchard. Open-source, self-hosted, Apache 2.0. Runs on Claude Code.

records.name: Athena Desktop
records.tagline: A local command room for AI coding agents.
records.description: Athena is a desktop control surface for AI coding agents with shared project context. Built with Electron, React, and FastAPI, it embeds native terminals for Codex, OpenCode, Claude, and Hermes with Hermes memory integration. Features MCP bridge for cross-platform workspace control, embedded PTY terminals, native session discovery, and more.

records.name: Human in the Love
records.tagline: The world's first MCP dating app inside Claude.
records.description: Everyone's so busy being productive with AI, so I built the opposite. Human in the Love is the world's first MCP dating app that runs inside Claude. You know 'human in the loop'? Forget the loop. It's love now. Beta users wanted.

records.name: Getusefeed
records.tagline: Feature voting & public roadmap for small SaaS teams.
records.description: Know what to build next. Collect feature requests, let users vote, and share your public roadmap. Flat pricing — no per-user fees. An affordable Canny alternative for small SaaS teams, startups, and solo founders.

records.name: Releasely
records.tagline: Three changelogs from every release -for indie SaaS founders
records.description: Releasely turns git commits into beautiful release notes. Pick one of three tones — technical, user-friendly, or marketing — and get polished output in 10 seconds. Built for solo founders who'd rather ship than write changelog entries.

records.name: Boxwood Chess
records.tagline: Chess pattern training. No timers, no streaks, no ratings.
records.description: Pattern training across 37,000 positions and 13 courses. No timers, no streaks, no ratings — just you and the board. Works offline. The first chapter of every course is free. Every purchase is one-time. Yours forever. Never a subscription.

records.name: Agata
records.tagline: AI text correction & translation via keyboard shortcuts.
records.description: Agata runs on Mac & Windows. Highlight text, hit a shortcut, and fix or translate it instantly. 100% private: it activates only on demand and sends data directly to your chosen API provider (BYOK). Enjoy the promo code STARTER30 for 30% off your first month. Offer limited to the first 50 subscribers.

records.name: Tadka
records.tagline: Ship 10x more ad creative, without hiring a design team.
records.description: Tadka turns one brief into hundreds of on-brand, audience-tuned ad creatives in minutes, then learns which ones win. The creative volume your Meta and Google campaigns are starving for.

records.name: Peak: Message Safety
records.tagline: Review your kid's texts. Nothing leaves your Mac
records.description: What is really in your kid's messages? Peak tells you, without sending a single byte to the cloud. Point it at an iPhone backup you already have and it scans iMessage and SMS for bullying, predators, self-harm, and drugs across nine categories. It even reads text hidden inside photos and screenshots. All on your Mac. No account, no subscription, nothing installed on the phone. One-time purchase. Your kid's privacy stays yours.

records.name: Sklm
records.tagline: Centralize, scope, and sync skills for every AI agent
records.description: Sklm is a CLI tool that centralizes management of skills (SKILL.md files) for your AI agents. It solves the tension between wanting skills globally available vs. per-project scoped, without polluting your agent's configuration. Multi-agent support - Global store - Registry discovery - Auto-sync

records.name: Fonty Menu Bar
records.tagline: Install Google Fonts right from your Mac menu bar.
records.description: Fonty Menu Bar is a Mac app that makes finding and installing Google Fonts faster. Instead of opening a browser, downloading ZIP files, unzipping folders, and managing font files manually, designers and creatives can browse, preview, and install fonts directly from the menu bar. It is lightweight, fast, and built to stay out of the way.

records.name: ZenVeil
records.tagline: Find, understand and fix security issues faster
records.description: ZenVeil helps developers find, understand, and fix security issues without the complexity of traditional security tools. Scan GitHub repositories, local codebases, and APIs for secrets, supply chain risks, and common security issues. Generate AI-powered explanations, remediation guidance, prioritize findings with AI triage, and create pull requests with fixes. Available through both a web dashboard and CLI.

records.name: Stride
records.tagline: The AI workspace that plans, designs and ships with you.
records.description: Stride is the AI-native workspace for the whole build: plan, design, verify, and ship. Its AI works inside your real project data and plugs into Claude Code and Codex over MCP, so it does the work instead of just talking about it. Your team goes from idea to launch without switching tools.

records.name: 1000Yen Eats
records.tagline: Find a real meal under ¥1,000 anywhere in Japan
records.description: 1000Yen Eats maps 25,000+ restaurants across 78 Japanese cities, every one with a real meal under ¥1,000. Filter by cuisine, sort by nearest or cheapest, save spots, browse any city offline. No signup, no ads, no tracking.

records.name: PeakRoutine
records.tagline: Personalized health coaching powered by your biomarkers
records.description: PeakRoutine connects your sleep, sunlight, exercise, calories, nutrition, mood, hydration, and more — correlates them against each other — then tells you exactly what it means for your body. No generic plans. Just a proactive AI coach that learns your biology and builds habits around it.

records.name: Goldfish
records.tagline: Press Option. It knows your work and replies like you
records.description: Most AI tools make you explain the context before they can help. Goldfish already has it. It privately remembers what you’ve been working on across your Mac, then helps you write better from any app. Press Option in a text field to draft replies, summarize threads, rewrite sentences, or recall important details from your recent work without copying, pasting, or re-explaining the whole backstory.

records.name: Keyboard Copilot
records.tagline: AI keyboard that rephrases, translates, and more in any app
records.description: Most AI tools interrupt your workflow. Keyboard Copilot brings AI directly to your keyboard, letting you rewrite, translate, fix grammar, change tone, and generate replies and more without switching apps. Built to feel fast, native, and useful wherever you type.

records.name: PrompTessor
records.tagline: AI Prompt Generator, Optimizer & Library
records.description: AI prompt workspace for generating, analyzing, optimizing, refining, and saving prompts. Turn ideas into structured prompts, evaluate prompt quality with clear metrics and estimated token usage, improve existing prompts, and convert images, videos, text, or URLs into reusable prompt patterns with Reverse Prompt. Organize your best prompts in the Prompt Library and use them with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, image and video generators, coding assistants, and other AI tools.

records.name: Invoko
records.tagline: A little hand on your Mac
records.description: Invoko is an AI desktop helper you can talk to while you work. Bring it beside anything on your screen, ask it questions, or let it handle tasks across your apps.

records.name: Cymatic
records.tagline: Meditation shaped by sound, breath, and frequency
records.description: Cymatic is a sound wellness app that helps you create personalized sessions for focus, sleep, relaxation, and emotional reset. Choose a healing frequency, layer music and natural atmospheres, then watch the sound transform into living visual patterns in real time. Alongside sound sessions, Cymatic includes guided meditations, breathwork practices, daily recommendations, and iOS widgets to make calm easier to return to throughout the day.

records.name: Writulos
records.tagline: Get clean structured docs instantly.
records.description: Paste code, get clean structured docs in seconds. Writulos supports multiple languages, GitHub Actions, shareable docs, saved history, API keys, and agent workflows.

records.name: PicOne
records.tagline: macOS menu bar image uploader, multi-provider, sandbox-safe
records.description: PicOne is a native macOS menu-bar image uploader with no Dock icon or main window. Upload via file picker, drag & drop, clipboard, or Finder right-click. Supports GitHub, S3-compatible (AWS/R2/COS/MinIO), Alibaba OSS, Qiniu, Upyun, Imgur, SM.MS, WebDAV, local folder & custom hosts. Built-in image processing (convert, compress, resize, watermark). MAS only, App Sandbox, zero third-party dependencies. Free trial available, then one-time purchase.

records.name: Shelly
records.tagline: Run OpenAI Codex CLI natively on Android
records.description: Shelly runs the OpenAI Codex CLI natively on Android — no PC, no Termux, no proot. It pairs a real native terminal with an Agent Chat pane that reads Codex output live and runs fixes with one tap. A home-screen Scouter widget shows quota, cost and rate limits, and lets you fire prompts straight from the home screen. Local LLMs (Qwen3.5 + llama.cpp) supported. Open source, GPLv3. Built entirely by directing AI agents — I don't write the code myself.

records.name: grnlght
records.tagline: The client delivery system that moves work forward.
records.description: Built on the belief that EMAILS SUCK, grnlght is a modern client delivery system designed to help agencies, freelancers, coaches, consultants, and service-based businesses manage every stage of their client relationships in one place. It gives you structured systems to track communication, tasks, approvals, and progress without the chaos of scattered tools. It's flexible and scalable enough to work whether you’re a solo freelancer or a full service agency,

records.name: Botme
records.tagline: AI customer support agent, live on your website in 5 minutes
records.description: Train it on your website, docs, or policies. Botme deploys an AI support agent that answers customers instantly, 24/7 in 90+ languages. Goes live in under 5 minutes. Beyond Q&A: it books meetings, captures leads, recommends WooCommerce products, and hands off to humans when needed. Every answer is grounded in your content with source citations. No hallucinations. Free to start.

records.name: Notum
records.tagline: AI-powered research and document intelligence for law firms.
records.description: Notum is a technology and AI partner helping law firms safely operationalize institutional knowledge. Rather than just selling software, we partner with firms to identify high-value opportunities, evaluate emerging technologies, and implement practical AI solutions that create measurable value while fitting into existing legal workflows.

records.name: GateOS
records.tagline: The all-in-one workspace for serious exam aspirants.
records.description: GateOS is an AI-powered learning workspace built for competitive exam aspirants, students and researchers. It brings planning, notes, AI tutoring, performance analytics, mistake tracking, mock-test insights, and revision workflows into a single platform. Instead of switching between multiple apps, students can manage their entire preparation journey in one place, helping them stay organized, focused, and continuously improve.

records.name: GlassKit UI
records.tagline: AI-ready React UI for Meta's Ray-Ban Display glasses
records.description: Open-source (MIT) React components for Meta Ray-Ban Display web apps. 44 components + a D-pad focus engine for the 600x600 lens, and built for AI agents: a skill, an MCP server, and llms.txt so Claude/Cursor build it right. Vendor shadcn-style; own the source.

records.name: SIFT
records.tagline: Break the hidden habits holding you back.
records.description: Most apps treat you like a machine that just needs a tighter schedule. SIFT is different: You don’t need more discipline, you just need to break the loop. SIFT is an interactive mind-mirror and cognitive debugging tool designed to outsmart mental freeze frames.

records.name: Pawly Extension
records.tagline: A virtual pet that lives in your browser.
records.description: Unlike virtual pets that are just GIFs, Pawly stands out for five reasons: Autonomous AI: Free-flowing behavior without predefined scripts. Tamagotchi System: Real-time hunger, energy, and mood tracking. Synchronization: Instantly moves to your active tab. Progression: Dynamic minigames, levels, and accessories. Productivity: Integrated notes and task manager. The only extension that combines real AI, virtual care, and utility.

records.name: AGIRAILS
records.tagline: Let AI agents hire and pay each other w/ on-chain settlement
records.description: AGIRAILS gives AI agents what people take for granted: a way to hire, pay, and get paid. Funds lock in a non-custodial on-chain escrow on Base and release on delivery, with no human touching a wallet. The transport is pluggable (we just ran a full settlement over plain email); the settlement is on-chain and verifiable.

records.name: ResumeWriting.com
records.tagline: The only AI tool designed specifically for resume writing
records.description: Paste your resume and a job posting — ResumeWriting.com tailors your resume to that specific role in under a minute, so you apply with a sharper, role-matched resume. Built by the team behind ResumeWriters.com, human resume experts since 1999.

records.name: LYQN AI
records.tagline: AI support that learns your business and hands off to humans
records.description: LYQN is a self-learning AI support agent. It crawls your site, grounds every reply in your knowledge base, hands off to a human in one click, and lets visitors continue the chat on WhatsApp. One-line install. 2 weeks free.

records.name: LLM Gateway Chat
records.tagline: One balance. Every model. Chat, image, video & audio.
records.description: LLM Gateway Chat is one playground for 210+ models — GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek & more. Switch models mid-conversation, run image/video/audio studios, and compare answers side by side. One balance covers it all. Subscriptions from $9/mo, or pay-as-you-go.

records.name: Covari
records.tagline: Forward manufacturing RFQs by email, no portals required
records.description: Forward your manufacturing RFQ by email with CAD, drawings, and BOMs. Covari automatically structures the request—extracting processes, materials, quantities, and finishes. No web portals, logins, or forms. Update details by replying directly to the thread, and get pricing matched to Covari's manufacturing network (CNC, sheet metal, 3D printing, injection molding).

records.name: GamerForge
records.tagline: Transform game, CGI, and VFX assets with AI
records.description: GamerForge helps studios modernize, restore, and transform the digital assets that power games, visual effects, animation, CGI, and real-time production. Using AI-powered enhancement workflows, teams can upscale textures, improve imagery, optimize assets, generate atlases, compress content, and prepare assets for modern pipelines. GamerForge is designed specifically for production asset workflows, supporting game development, VFX, animation, digital preservation, and content modernization.

records.name: yousaidthat.org
records.tagline: Prove that you said things before anyone else
records.description: YouSaidThat lets you seal any prediction. A market call, a hot take, a thesis — with SHA-256 hashing, AES-256-GCM encryption, and RFC 3161 timestamps. No one can see it until you reveal it. Once you do, anyone can verify you wrote it exactly then, without trusting you or any platform. Built on open cryptographic standards. No accounts needed. Fully auditable. Your proof lives outside any server.

records.name: BossMode
records.tagline: The focus app that shows your mom when you procrastinate
records.description: Every other focus app shows you a quiet block page and asks you to breathe. BossMode fullscreens someone you're genuinely scared of — your mom, your boss, a crying child — the second you open Instagram during work hours. You get a shame counter, escalating lockout timers, dramatic sound effects, and a brutal end-of-day roast notification. Free to install. $6.99 once to unlock your own photos/videos, all 5 character packs, and the full shame experience. No subscription. Shame is forever.

records.name: SocialKit
records.tagline: Post to 11 social platforms in seconds, on one flat plan
records.description: All-in-one social media scheduler: create, customize, and schedule posts to 11 platforms — from Instagram and TikTok to Bluesky, Mastodon, and Google Business — on one flat EUR plan. AI, analytics, and API + webhooks on every tier. 7-day free trial.

records.name: Canopy
records.tagline: Parallel, sandboxed Claude Code sessions on native macOS
records.description: Canopy runs parallel Claude Code sessions as tabs in one native macOS window — each in its own git worktree, each its own Claude. Close the app and every session resumes with its conversation intact. One-click "Merge & Finish" handles the merge-and-cleanup dance, a split shell pane lets you run git without interrupting Claude, and an Activity dashboard shows where your tokens actually went. Native SwiftUI, no Electron. macOS 14+, AGPL-3.0. Built by someone who uses it daily.

records.name: YoAmigo Studio
records.tagline: Ship real apps on the AI you already pay for.
records.description: YoAmigo wraps the command line coding agents you already use, like Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity CLI, in a local-first desktop app that handles the boilerplate: databases, payments, and auth. You own the code, no AI credits to buy. You run your own agents on the AI subscription you already pay for. Built for founders who want the best tools without the markup.

records.name: Publia
records.tagline: What AI makes, Publia ships.
records.description: Hey PH 👋 My AI could make a great page — but getting it online at a real link was always the annoying part. So Publia does one thing: what AI makes, Publia ships. Add the skill to Claude or Codex once — npx skills@latest add getpublia/skills — then just say "publish this." You get a real web page at your own link, you.publia.sh. No setup, no server. No AI handy? Drag files into publia.ai, or push from the terminal. It's early — what would you publish first? 🚀

records.name: Dinamo Notebook
records.tagline: Professional football/soccer analysis, right in your browser
records.description: Dinamo Notebook turns your browser into a professional football analysis platform. Analyze matches from YouTube, Twitch, Dailymotion, or local files with timestamped notes, player and event tagging, tactical diagrams, and animated sequences. Optional AI assistance works with your own API key. Everything stays on your machine — no subscriptions, no cloud lock-in. Export polished PDF and HTML reports, GIFs, highlight reels, and portable project backups whenever you're ready to share your analysis.

records.name: Fantasma
records.tagline: Landing page builder for Ghost CMS
records.description: Fantasma helps you build Ghost landing pages with sections Source doesn't ship: hero, FAQ, stats, CTA, feature grids, and more. Same Source look, visual editing, no theme files. Export a standard ZIP (free) or publish to Ghost (Pro). Real Handlebars you can hand to a client. https://www.fantasma.io/

records.name: ClientJam
records.tagline: AI-powered lead generation for designers and agencies
records.description: Most lead generation apps tell you who a business is. ClientJam tells you how badly they need you — then writes the pitch. Paste any URL for a plain-English audit (SSL, mobile, speed, SEO), an opportunity score ranking leads by ripeness, and 3 ready-to-send emails built from the site's real flaws. City Prospector pulls 20 leads from any city worldwide. Anyone can list contacts — ClientJam scores intent from a real audit and writes the outreach. The gap between a list and a booked call.

records.name: Subotiz
records.tagline: Smarter Monetization. Subscribe. Sell. Scale.
records.description: The Subscription Growth Engine built for AI and SaaS. Get paid as early as T+7, native token metering, and global tax compliance out-of-the-box.

records.name: Kraina
records.tagline: Turn your outdoor activities into a territory game.
records.description: Kraina turns outdoor movement into a living territory map. Unlike standard apps that show thin route corridors, Kraina lets you draw loops to reveal the land inside. The map is alive: with Rolling Fog, places you stop visiting can fade back, giving you a reason to return and reclaim your territory. Explore with purpose through missions and challenge zones. Now on Web and iPhone.

records.name: Glint
records.tagline: Claude Code activity, right where you want it.
records.description: Glint is a lightweight macOS menu-bar app that surfaces what your Claude Code sessions are doing - live status, the current tool, token spend, the plan, subagents, usage meters, and context window - in a glanceable island near your notch, a floating pill, or beside the Dock. Reads ~/.claude locally; your session data never leaves your Mac. Support for other providers like Codex, Kiro and etc are on the roadmap to be release ASAP!

records.name: Voice Calls in Chatwoot
records.tagline: Calls, chats, and emails all in one support inbox
records.description: Chatwoot Voice has everything your support team needs to handle customer calls without leaving the inbox: browser-based calling, inbound and outbound phone support, Twilio Voice integration, WhatsApp calling support, call recordings, transcripts, AI summaries, call history, and customer context in one conversation thread.

records.name: DevCleaner
records.tagline: Free the gigabytes your dev tools and AI apps hoard
records.description: DevCleaner lives in your Mac's menu bar and frees the gigabytes that 22 dev ecosystems quietly hoard — Xcode, Gradle, npm, plus AI apps like Cursor, Claude & Ollama. Every item is risk-rated, so you always know what's safe to delete. Free, no account, 4 MB.

records.name: Revyl
records.tagline: The mobile source of truth
records.description: Revyl gives mobile teams full observability into how their app actually behaves on live cloud devices. Step-level execution traces, performance data (CPU, memory, FPS), a complete network waterfall, and state and file-system diffing across every run. Atlas auto-maps every screen and flow in your app, and revyl dev brings hot reload and device control into your dev loop.

records.name: Dirac

records.tagline: One app. From planning to delivery, lead to support
records.description: Mosic is one app for the work you do across separate apps today. It combines project management, a CRM, a helpdesk, a shared email communications and Documents and it ties them together at the record level. Plan projects with a 5-level hierarchy, Today view, and Gantt with critical path. Sell with lead scoring, pipelines, and one-click lead-to-customer conversion, Support with live SLA countdowns and smart routing, Connect Claude or ChatGPT to run any of it through your AI.

records.name: BLOKR
records.tagline: Block distractions on your browser AND your phone.
records.description: Block Reels, Shorts & TikTok with a browser extension or an App that actually sticks. Plus 10 free built-in tools: Pomodoro, Eisenhower matrix, meeting cost ticker, goblin task breaker, stoic life calendar & more. Free plan. No bloat.

records.name: TerraWatch
records.tagline: Terraform security that lives inside the pull request
records.description: TerraWatch scans every Terraform PR, blocks the merge if it finds security issues, and posts the exact code fix in the PR comment. No YAML. No CLI. No Checkov. 2 minute setup. 29 AWS rules. Free during beta. - Hardcoded diffs, not AI generated - Nothing auto-applied, you review every fix - Only reads changedtf files, never your full codebase

records.name: Goldfish
records.tagline: Press Option. It knows your work and replies like you
records.description: Most AI tools make you explain the context before they can help. Goldfish already has it. It privately remembers what you’ve been working on across your Mac, then helps you write better from any app. Press Option in a text field to draft replies, summarize threads, rewrite sentences, or recall important details from your recent work without copying, pasting, or re-explaining the whole backstory.

records.name: Cortis: Offline AI Assistant
records.tagline: AI help when there’s no internet
records.description: Cortis is a private AI assistant that works even when you have no internet connection. Use it while camping, traveling, flying, or anywhere your signal disappears. Ask questions, get explanations, and access helpful information directly on your iPhone without relying on the cloud. As a thank you to the Product Hunt community, I've created a limited number of free premium codes. If you're genuinely interested in testing Cortis, send me a message and I'd love to hear your feedback.

records.name: Fantasma
records.tagline: Landing page builder for Ghost CMS
records.description: Fantasma helps you build Ghost landing pages with sections Source doesn't ship: hero, FAQ, stats, CTA, feature grids, and more. Same Source look, visual editing, no theme files. Export a standard ZIP (free) or publish to Ghost (Pro). Real Handlebars you can hand to a client. https://www.fantasma.io/

records.name: FreelancerGuard
records.tagline: Catch client red flags. Respond without the panic.
records.description: Most scope creep tools help after the project has already started. FreelancerGuard starts earlier when the first client message feels off, and you still have room to clarify, price differently, or walk away. Red Flag Detector: paste any client inquiry and get an instant risk score across 5 categories: scope creep, payment dodging, devaluation, relationship red flags, and power imbalance. Scope Creep Email Generator: when scope expands mid-project, get a calm boundary-setting reply in seconds.

records.name: Drilo : AI Courses, Quizzes & Flashcards
records.tagline: Turn notes, files & videos into AI study tools
records.description: Most learning apps focus on one thing—flashcards, quizzes, notes, or courses. Drilo combines them into a complete AI learning experience. Upload PDFs, notes, textbooks, documents, or YouTube videos, and Drilo turns them into structured courses with lessons, quizzes, flashcards, active recall practice, and personalized learning paths. Instead of summarizing content, Drilo transforms it into an interactive study system designed for understanding, retention, and exam preparation.

records.name: MindReader v1
records.tagline: Read minds (simulated fMRI data, channeled to neuro-metrics)
records.description: How do you feel? It is the oldest question in art and the newest one we can answer in technology. MindReader takes your content and simulates, region by region, how a brain responds to it. Completely Open Source - we encourage you to tinker. Exploring sales evals, neural evals for datasets and other esoteric product experiments w/ madhat founders. MindReader is built on Meta FAIR's TRIBE v2 + 35yrs of neuro research. Inviting collab from the academics et all.

records.name: Agency MGMT. software release
records.tagline: Perfectly Connected.
records.description: We can generate our own fonts with a builder and host them Advance image generation system, ai tags the images unique color system, built from scratch, based on the LAB system Color palette/catalog is larger than existing systems different colors modes automated between dark and light Security built in, real time monitoring SSE-live streaming all ai tools connected our own agent running generates css

records.name: Flara Pro
records.tagline: AI skin trigger tracker for flare patterns
records.description: Flara Pro tracks skin reactions, foods, weather, cosmetics, stress, sleep, and photos, then summarizes likely flare triggers into a daily skin score, 30-day heatmap, AI trigger analysis, and dermatologist-ready PDF exports.
